title: Revealing the Biological Effect of the N-glycosylation of High-Mobility Group Box 1 (HMGB1) Facilitated by Chemical Protein Synthesis.
authors: Zhong, Zhixiang; Zhou, Haiyan; Huang, Zirong; Zhang, Yaoyue; Wang, Jiaqi; Liu, Han; Li, Xuechen
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
one_liner_zh: 该文通过化学蛋白合成研究HMGB1的N-糖基化对其与受体RAGE互作的影响，虽含MD模拟但核心是糖基化修饰而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: N-glycosylation is one of the most ubiquitous protein post-translational modifications with both high structural diversity and critical functions in broad molecular biological processes. The effect of N-glycans on high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) has not been clearly elucidated. Chemical protein synthesis, in combination with enzymatic transglycosylation, provides a robust approach to obtain homogeneous N-glycoproteins with well-defined glycan structures on designated sites, therefore allowing the investigation of the biological effects of N-glycosylation on site- and structure-specific levels. In this work, the synthetic route toward full-length fully reduced HMBG1 was established, which was adopted to the syntheses of N-glycosylated HMBG1 variants bearing sialylated biantennary N-glycans. The synthetic N-glycoproteins were employed to investigate the effects of N-glycosylation on the interactions of HMGB1 with receptors RAGE, as well as the HMGB1-stimulated cell migration and CXCL12 secretion. The potential effect of N-glycans on the HMGB1/RAGE interaction was investigated via molecular dynamics simulations.
abstract_zh: N-糖基化是最普遍的蛋白质翻译后修饰之一，具有高度的结构多样性，并在广泛的分子生物学过程中发挥关键功能。N-聚糖对高迁移率族蛋白盒1（HMGB1）的影响尚未被明确阐明。化学蛋白质合成结合酶促转糖基化，提供了一种稳健的方法，以获得在指定位点上具有明确聚糖结构的均质N-糖蛋白，从而能够在位点和结构特异性水平上研究N-糖基化的生物学效应。在本工作中，建立了全长完全还原型HMGB1的合成路线，并将其应用于携带唾液酸化双天线N-聚糖的N-糖基化HMGB1变体的合成。利用合成的N-糖蛋白研究了N-糖基化对HMGB1与受体RAGE相互作用的影响，以及HMGB1刺激的细胞迁移和CXCL12分泌。通过分子动力学模拟研究了N-聚糖对HMGB1/RAGE相互作用的潜在影响。
